findings.title: An annual alias can launder point stock as recognized annual revenue
findings.cause: validate_windowed_composition returns for annual derived facts without period_flow ancestors; validate_annual_consumption trusts the outer annual basis. Typed monetary_balance point ancestry is never checked.
findings.actual: validate_document -> run_forecast -> validate_published_forecast -> validate_forecast_output accepts point monetary_balance 20 via annual revenue x0 alias, increases FY2026 low revenue from 150 to 170, and both strong readers PASS.
findings.expected: A pure relabeling of a point stock cannot establish recognized annual flow. Reject at the business contract, not due to registry write permissions.
findings.control: The same stock alias labeled period_flow is correctly rejected with flow-bearing input diagnostic.
findings.repair_scope: Use unified typed ancestry for annual/datetime wrappers; do not blanket-reject native legitimate stock quantity times annual price/ARPU, stock-flow bridge models, or annual-only legacy drafts.
